# Stage 3 Review Fixtures

`fixture-manifest.json` is project-authored deterministic test data. It
describes abstract chord labels, integer sample-frame ranges, and expected
review operations; it contains no recording, melody, lyrics, or third-party
material.

The fixture is dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0. Its authorization
scope is automated local testing, documentation examples, and redistribution
with ChordAtlas.
